Subject: Request for a Quieter Meeting Room

Hi Facilities Team,

I hope you’re well. I’m writing to request a quieter meeting room for an upcoming meeting that requires minimal background noise (we’ll be recording and need uninterrupted discussion). Our usual room has been noisy lately, so could you please help either reserve a quieter room or suggest alternatives that meet the following needs?

- Date/time: [insert date and time] (or recurring: [insert schedule])  
- Capacity: [number of attendees]  
- AV needs: [e.g., projector, conference phone, recording setup]  

If you can move our current reservation or recommend available rooms, that would be much appreciated. Please let me know what options are available and any next steps I should take.

Thank you for your help.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]  
[Department / Team]  
[Phone or email]
